originalTitle: Tenet Healthcare (THC) Outpaces Stock Market Gains: What You Should Know
summary: Tenet Healthcare (THC) reached $258.62 at the closing of the latest trading day, reflecting a +1.83% change compared to its last close.
content:
In the latest close session, Tenet Healthcare (THC) was up +1.83% at $258.62. The stock outpaced the S&P 500's daily gain of 0.73%. On the other hand, the Dow registered a gain of 0.49%, and the technology-centric Nasdaq increased by 1.19%.

Shares of the hospital operator have depreciated by 3.61% over the course of the past month, outperforming the Medical sector's loss of 3.74%, and lagging the S&P 500's gain of 0.55%.

Analysts and investors alike will be keeping a close eye on the performance of Tenet Healthcare in its upcoming earnings disclosure. The company's upcoming EPS is projected at $4.59, signifying a 24.05% increase compared to the same quarter of the previous year. Meanwhile, our latest consensus estimate is calling for revenue of $5.47 billion, up 3.4% from the prior-year quarter.

Regarding the entire year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates forecast earnings of $21.04 per share and revenue of $22.2 billion, indicating changes of +25.39% and +4.18%, respectively, compared to the previous year.

Investors should also note any recent changes to analyst estimates for Tenet Healthcare. These revisions typically reflect the latest short-term business trends, which can change frequently. Hence, positive alterations in estimates signify analyst optimism regarding the business and profitability.

Our research suggests that these changes in estimates have a direct relationship with upcoming stock price performance. To exploit this, we've formed the Zacks Rank, a quantitative model that includes these estimate changes and presents a viable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which ranges from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), has an impressive outside-audited track record of outperformance, with #1 stocks generating an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has witnessed a 0.02% decrease. Tenet Healthcare is holding a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold) right now.

In the context of valuation, Tenet Healthcare is at present trading with a Forward P/E ratio of 12.07. This expresses no noticeable deviation compared to the average Forward P/E of 12.07 of its industry.

It's also important to note that THC currently trades at a PEG ratio of 0.97. This popular metric is similar to the widely-known P/E ratio, with the difference being that the PEG ratio also takes into account the company's expected earnings growth rate. The Medical - Hospital industry had an average PEG ratio of 1.08 as trading concluded yesterday.

The Medical - Hospital industry is part of the Medical sector. With its current Zacks Industry Rank of 62, this industry ranks in the top 26% of all industries, numbering over 250.

The Zacks Industry Rank assesses the strength of our separate industry groups by calculating the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks contained within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

You can find more information on all of these metrics, and much more, on Zacks.com.

chineseTitle: Tenet Healthcare (THC) 的涨幅超过股市：您应该知道什么
chineseSummary: Tenet Healthcare (THC) 在最近一个交易日收盘时达到 258.62 美元，较上一交易日收盘价上涨 +1.83%。
chineseContent:
在最近的收盘交易中，Tenet Healthcare (THC) 上涨 1.83%，至 258.62 美元。该股的日涨幅超过标准普尔 500 指数 0.73%。另一方面，道指上涨0.49%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨1.19%。

过去一个月，该医院运营商的股价下跌了 3.61%，跑赢了医疗板块 3.74% 的跌幅，落后于标准普尔 500 指数 0.55% 的涨幅。

分析师和投资者都将密切关注 Tenet Healthcare 在即将公布的收益披露中的表现。该公司即将公布的每股收益预计为4.59美元，较去年同期增长24.05%。与此同时，我们最新的共识预测收入为 54.7 亿美元，比去年同期增长 3.4%。

就全年而言，Zacks 一致预期每股收益为 21.04 美元，营收为 222 亿美元，与上年相比分别变化 +25.39% 和 +4.18%。

投资者还应注意分析师对 Tenet Healthcare 的估​​计最近的任何变化。这些修订通常反映最新的短期业务趋势，这些趋势可能经常变化。因此，预测的积极变化表明分析师对业务和盈利能力持乐观态度。

我们的研究表明，这些预估变化与即将到来的股价表现有直接关系。为了利用这一点，我们形成了 Zacks Rank，这是一个定量模型，其中包括这些估计变化并提供了一个可行的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统的范围从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），具有令人印象深刻的外部审计表现优异记录，自 1988 年以来#1 股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计下降了 0.02%。 Tenet Healthcare 目前的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

在估值方面，Tenet Healthcare 目前的远期市盈率为 12.07。与行业平均远期市盈率 12.07 相比，这并没有明显的偏差。

还需要注意的是，THC 目前的 PEG 比率为 0.97。这个流行的指标与广为人知的市盈率类似，不同之处在于，PEG比率还考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天交易结束，医疗-医院行业的平均 PEG 率为 1.08。

医疗-医院行业是医疗行业的一部分。目前该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 62 位，在所有行业中排名前 26%，数量超过 250 个。

Zacks 行业排名通过计算各行业组中包含的个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们各个行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
